official_scope.effective_program: June 8 and 10, 2026 PRC Architecture program; latest located as of 2026-10-04.

visual_suitability.source: Stored editorial metadata; no keyword inference.

plans.proposition_summary: Select a passive climate response from stated sun, wind, rainfall, and material constraints.
plans.novelty_basis: Bounded climate-and-material application distinct from recognition.
limitations: Keep propositions tied to stated climate and material evidence; do not treat form recognition as proof.

plans.proposition_summary: Resolve a consultant interface by checking information status, authority, and downstream coordination.
plans.novelty_basis: Controlled change scenario, not a coordination definition paraphrase.
limitations: Use controlled coordination scenarios with a stated decision record; do not claim a universal project answer.

plans.proposition_summary: Prioritize a public-safety or accessibility response when client preference conflicts with a stated user risk.
plans.novelty_basis: Fact-specific professional judgment with users and consequences stated.
limitations: Keep regulatory references current and distinguish professional judgment from a final legal determination.

plans.proposition_summary: Choose the conceptual structural system whose load path matches stated span and support assumptions.
plans.novelty_basis: Explicit load-path reasoning without sealed member design.
limitations: Conceptual reasoning only; any numerical proposition requires an independently recomputable calculation record.

plans.proposition_summary: Select a coordinated water, drainage, ventilation, or life-safety response from stated service constraints.
plans.novelty_basis: Cross-system consequence distinct from isolated component recognition.
limitations: Version-sensitive requirements must be rechecked; calculation propositions require independent recomputation.

plans.proposition_summary: Recompute a bounded construction quantity from explicit measurement and waste assumptions.
plans.novelty_basis: Independent recomputation with a stored unit and assumption record.
limitations: Keep quantities independently recomputable and avoid treating one construction sequence as universally controlling.

plans.proposition_summary: Choose the circulation or egress response satisfying stated adjacency, accessibility, and wayfinding constraints.
plans.novelty_basis: Complete text-specified scenario; no unstated plan comparison.
limitations: Text-only items must state all geometry needed for the decision; visual alternatives are not authorized here.

plans.proposition_summary: Compare a phasing or site-capacity alternative against stated access, service, landscape, and growth criteria.
plans.novelty_basis: Criteria-based site scenario with all decision constraints stated.
limitations: Text-only items must contain the complete capacity assumptions and are bounded to planning reasoning.

plans.proposition_summary: Distinguish a climate-responsive vernacular adaptation from a decorative form transfer under changed conditions.
plans.novelty_basis: Performance-logic transfer rather than image identification.
limitations: Keep propositions tied to stated climate and material evidence; do not treat form recognition as proof.

plans.proposition_summary: Record and communicate an authorized design change while preserving drawing and specification interfaces.
plans.novelty_basis: Change-control record distinct from interface resolution.
limitations: Use controlled coordination scenarios with a stated decision record; do not claim a universal project answer.

plans.proposition_summary: Communicate material uncertainty or a specialist boundary while protecting public responsibility.
plans.novelty_basis: Communication/referral scenario distinct from safety prioritization.
limitations: Keep regulatory references current and distinguish professional judgment from a final legal determination.

plans.proposition_summary: Recompute a bounded service quantity from stated flow, duration, and units, then check coordination implications.
plans.novelty_basis: Independent recomputation plus interface check; no specialist sizing claim.
limitations: Version-sensitive requirements must be rechecked; calculation propositions require independent recomputation.
